source_conflicts.title: Buffer thickness
source_conflicts.source_difference: Main Methods p775 states 25 nm between stacks; main p773, SI TableS1 and Section7 state or prefer 50 nm.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Qualified material card must name selected source variant and rationale. Neither value becomes the default.

source_conflicts.title: Printed current ratio
source_conflicts.source_difference: Main Eq1 prints ION/IOFF = ID,OFF / ID,SAT, conflicting with ratio prose and large reported ratios.
source_conflicts.required_handling: No ratio computation until an independently approved equation disposition is supplied. Never silently invert.

source_conflicts.title: Printed mobility
source_conflicts.source_difference: Main Eq2 prints mobility = L/(W Ci) * dID,lin/dVG without an explicit drain-voltage factor.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Dimensional and definition review required before mobility calculation; do not substitute a conventional formula silently.

source_conflicts.title: Printed subthreshold swing
source_conflicts.source_difference: Main Eq3 visibly prints d(log10 ID)/dVG minus 1 as a baseline subtraction, not a reciprocal.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Keep the printed expression in the conflict ledger only; require an approved metric definition before SS analysis.

source_conflicts.title: Mobility population scope
source_conflicts.source_difference: Headline maximum is 15 cm2/V/s; TableS2 lists DG 15.86±0.29 and 16.64±0.28; separate 100-device cohort reaches 19.72.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Keep cohort-specific outcomes. No global maximum or merged success threshold.

source_conflicts.title: Threshold sign and narrative ranges
source_conflicts.source_difference: Main DG range begins +0.31 V; TableS2 S9 is −0.31±0.17 V. BG/TG narrative ranges also differ from table entries.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Retain narrative and table evidence separately; no sign normalization or invented statistical resolution.

source_conflicts.title: Cohorts and uncertainty
source_conflicts.source_difference: Baseline N=12 per stack across three chips/four systems; reliability and transient 100 per architecture; long-term SI says 50 devices without clear per-architecture allocation. Main broadly groups them under 100.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Separate cohort IDs and qualified long-term allocation; ± remains undefined, never assigned SD or SEM.

source_conflicts.title: Coupling caption
source_conflicts.source_difference: FigS25 caption repeats BG2-to-BG1 for iii/iv; Section7 and panels identify TG1-to-BG2 and BG2-to-TG1.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Preserve both interpretations; no coupling execution without reviewed terminal-map disposition.

source_conflicts.title: Surface label
source_conflicts.source_difference: FigS7 stack7 BG appears as 251±1.66 nm; Section4 states layer RMS no more than 4 nm.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Retain literal anomaly; do not silently turn 251 into 2.51 or adopt it as a process target.

source_conflicts.title: Leakage magnitude
source_conflicts.source_difference: Main p772 describes DG leakage near 1e-12 A; SI Section6 p39 describes 1e-10 A as safe.
source_conflicts.required_handling: Bind leakage to actual curve, cohort and bias; never zero leakage or a universal acceptance threshold.

provenance.geometry: Original authored generic geometry. No source images, vendor CAD, source-traced layouts or copied figure geometry. Generic code helpers adapted from original Apache-2.0 sucrose package.
provenance.counting_policy: Six semantic groups are not six independently novel asset families. Repeated parts, labels, layers and exports never inflate unique-asset counts.
